q: Humans ___ on Mars one day, scientists believe.
explain: 对未来的简单预测用一般将来时 will + 动词原形。

q: At 7 p.m. tomorrow, I ___ over the North Pole.
explain: 将来某一时刻正在进行的动作用将来进行时 will be + V-ing。

q: Look at those black clouds — it ___ rain.
explain: 有明显迹象的预测用 be going to。

q: "The bag is heavy." "OK, I ___ help you."
explain: 说话当下临时做出的决定用 will。

q: This time tomorrow, the astronauts ___ experiments in the greenhouse.
explain: This time tomorrow 表将来某刻正进行，用将来进行时。

q: ___ you ___ the laptop tonight? I'd like to borrow it.
explain: 用将来进行时礼貌询问对方的计划。

q: I've already decided: I ___ watch the Mars landing live tonight.
explain: 早已计划好的打算用 be going to。

q: By 2100, people ___ in space cities, some scientists predict.
explain: 对遥远未来的预测用一般将来时 will。

q: Don't call her at three — she ___ the test then.
explain: 将来某时正在进行的动作用将来进行时。

q: I promise I ___ you tonight after the show.
explain: 承诺用 will。

q: By 1904, Helen Keller ___ from university.
explain: "到1904年"之前已完成的动作用过去完成时 had + 过去分词。

q: When I reached the station, the train ___ already ___.
explain: 过去时间点之前已发生用过去完成时 had + 过去分词。

q: She ___ ten new words before her teacher arrived.
explain: 在另一个过去动作(arrived)之前完成，用过去完成时。

q: After she ___ her homework, she went out to play.
explain: after 引导的较早动作用过去完成时。

q: He ___ never ___ of her before he read the book.
explain: before 之前的经历，用过去完成时 had + 过去分词。

q: By the age of 10, he ___ to five countries.
explain: "到10岁时"之前累计完成，用过去完成时。

q: Choose the sentence that correctly shows the earlier action with the past perfect.
options: She had waited for an hour before her teacher came.
She waited for an hour before her teacher had come.
She has waited before her teacher came.
explain: 较早动作(waited)用过去完成，较晚动作(came)用一般过去。

q: ___ you ever ___ of Helen Keller before reading her letter?
explain: 以过去某点(reading)为参照的之前经历，用过去完成时疑问 Had ... heard。

q: The room was empty; everyone ___ home.
explain: 在过去(was empty)之前已发生，用过去完成时。

q: When we got to the cinema, the film ___.
explain: 到达之前电影已开演，用过去完成时。

q: Mount Everest is ___ mountain in the world.
explain: 单音节形容词 tall 最高级为 the tallest。

q: The Taj Mahal is ___ at sunset than at noon.
explain: 多音节形容词 beautiful 比较级为 more beautiful。

q: Asia is ___ continent on Earth.
explain: large 最高级为 the largest。

q: Shanghai is one of ___ cities in the world.
explain: busy 以辅音+y结尾，最高级为 the busiest。

q: Laos is ___ Vietnam.
explain: "不如……"用 not as + 形容词原级 + as。

q: This is ___ film I have ever seen.
explain: interesting 最高级为 the most interesting。

q: Which sentence is correct?
options: The Gobi is bigger than the Taklamakan.
The Gobi is more bigger than the Taklamakan.
The Gobi is biggest than the Taklamakan.
explain: 一次只用一个比较标志，big 比较级为 bigger，不能说 more bigger。

q: My English is ___ than before, but still not good enough.
explain: good 的比较级是不规则形式 better。

q: China is almost ___ the whole of Europe.
explain: "和……一样大"用 as + 原级 + as。

q: Of all the students, Tom runs ___.
explain: fast 最高级为 the fastest。

q: If we recycle more, we ___ trees.
explain: 第一型条件句：if + 一般现在, will + 动词原形。

q: If it ___ tomorrow, the picnic will be cancelled.
explain: 第一型条件句的 if 从句用一般现在时。

q: If I ___ a scientist, I would study climate change.
explain: 第二型(与现在相反)：if + 过去时(be 用 were), would + 动词。

q: If everyone walked to school, the air ___ cleaner.
explain: 第二型条件句主句用 would + 动词原形。

q: If I ___ you, I would go home now.
explain: 第二型条件句中 be 动词各人称都用 were。

q: ___ we save water, we will be in trouble.
explain: Unless = If ... not，"除非我们节水，否则会有麻烦"。

q: If the oceans ___ by ten metres, many cities would disappear.
explain: 想象的未来(第二型)，if 从句用一般过去时 rose。

q: ___ you help us if we asked?
explain: 第二型条件句的疑问主句用 would。

q: What ___ if nobody acts?
explain: 对真实可能的将来发问，用第一型 will happen。

q: When the sun ___, the temperature will fall.
explain: when 引导真实且确定的时间状语从句，用一般现在时表将来。

q: I ___ in Shanghai since 2010.
explain: since + 时间点，用现在完成时 have + 过去分词。

q: We ___ friends for ten years.
explain: for + 时间段，用现在完成时。

q: ___ you ever ___ a lion dance?
explain: ever 与现在完成时连用：Have you ever seen...?

q: I have ___ tried mooncakes before.
explain: "从没"用 never 与现在完成时连用。

q: He has ___ to Beijing — he is still there now.
explain: has gone to 表示"去了还没回"。

q: He has ___ to Beijing twice; he loves the city.
explain: has been to 表示"去过(已回来)"的经历。

q: Have you finished your homework ___?
explain: yet 用于疑问句末，表示"还(没)"。

q: Which uses the simple past correctly with a definite past time?
options: I saw the film last night.
I have seen the film last night.
I see the film last night.
explain: 有明确过去时间(last night)用一般过去时，不用现在完成时。

q: She has ___ arrived, so she is still putting down her bags.
explain: just 与现在完成时连用，表"刚刚"。

q: We ___ each other since primary school.
explain: since + 时间点，用现在完成时 have known。

q: We stayed inside ___ it was raining.
explain: because 引导原因状语从句。

q: The gift sounded bad in Chinese, ___ we chose another one.
explain: so 表结果，"所以"。

q: I like Chinese food. ___, I can't eat spicy food.
explain: However 表转折，较正式，位于句首后接逗号。

q: ___ he is new here, he has already learned many customs.
explain: Although 引导让步状语从句，"尽管"。

q: He was late; ___, the meeting was delayed.
explain: therefore 表结果，较正式，常用于分号后。

q: Which sentence is correct?
options: Because it rained, we stayed home.
Because it rained, so we stayed home.
So it rained, because we stayed home.
explain: because 和 so 不能在同一句中同时使用。

q: ___ it was her first time in China, she felt at home.
explain: Even though 表让步，"即使/尽管"。

q: Chinese tea is famous, ___ not every Chinese person drinks it every day.
explain: yet 表转折，相当于 but。

q: ___ you are tired, please rest for a while.
explain: Since 在此表原因，"既然"。

q: We gave candy ___ it is sweet and lucky.
explain: because 引导原因。

q: "I wandered lonely as a cloud" uses which device?
explain: 含 as 把人比作云，是明喻(simile)。

q: "Time is a river." This sentence is a ___.
explain: 直接说 X 是 Y，不用 like/as，是暗喻(metaphor)。

q: "The wind whispered in the trees." This is an example of ___.
explain: 把人的动作(whisper)赋予风，是拟人(personification)。

q: "I have a dream. I have a dream. I have a dream today." This uses ___.
explain: 同一句反复出现以增强节奏与情感，是重复(repetition)。

q: "Silver streams, sleepy stars, silent night" is an example of ___.
explain: 邻近词开头相同辅音 /s/，是头韵(alliteration)。

q: Which one is a simile?
explain: 含 like 的比较是明喻。

q: Which one is a metaphor?
explain: 直接说"书是门"、不用 like/as，是暗喻。

q: "The boy runs as fast as a deer." The device is ___.
explain: as...as 结构作比较，是明喻。

q: "'Hope' is the thing with feathers" treats hope as a bird without 'like'. This is ___.
explain: 不用 like/as 直接把希望当作鸟，是暗喻。

q: Why do poets use figurative language?
options: To make readers see and feel more
explain: 修辞把想法变成画面，让读者"看见"与"感受"更多。

q: Direct: "I love you." Reported: He said he ___ her.
explain: 引述动词为过去时，现在时 love 变为过去时 loved。

q: Direct: "I am writing a play." Reported: She said she ___ a play.
explain: 现在进行时 am writing 在间接引语中变为 was writing。

q: Direct: "I have seen him." Reported: She said she ___ him.
explain: 现在完成时 have seen 变为过去完成时 had seen。

q: Direct: "I will visit Verona." Reported: Juliet said she ___ Verona.
explain: will 在间接引语中变为 would。

q: Direct: "Go home!" Reported: He told her ___ home.
explain: 祈使句(命令)转述用 tell sb. to + 动词原形。

q: Direct: "Don't be late." Reported: She asked him ___ late.
explain: 否定祈使句转述用 ask sb. not to + 动词原形。

q: Direct: "Did you read it?" Reported: She asked me ___ it.
explain: 一般疑问句转述用 if，时态后移为过去完成时。

q: Direct: "Where does he live?" Reported: She asked where he ___.
explain: 特殊疑问句转述保留疑问词、改陈述语序、时态后移为 lived。

q: He ___ that he would come back soon.
explain: promise(承诺)后接 that 从句，符合语境。

q: The teacher said that the Earth ___ round.
explain: 客观真理在间接引语中时态可保留现在时。
